sources.title: Black Holes and Large N Species Solution to the Hierarchy Problem

evidence.text: Can a TeV sector with roughly 10³² species, or an admissible cyclic charge capacity of comparable size, account for the gravitational hierarchy?

sources.title: Phenomenology of $10^{32}$ Dark Sectors

evidence.text: Can approximately 10^{32} permutation-related Standard Model copies explain a low gravitational cutoff while satisfying low-energy constraints, and what signatures follow for microscopic black holes, neutron mixing, neutrino masses, proton stability, and dark matter?

sources.title: How neutrino protects the axion

evidence.text: Can the gravitational anomaly of neutrino lepton number protect the axion solution to strong CP from dangerous gravitational effects, and what conditional upper bound follows for the lightest neutrino mass?

sources.title: Dark Matter and Global Symmetries

evidence.text: Can continuous global symmetries stabilize dark matter if gravitational effects break them at the Planck scale, once observational bounds on dimension-five decay operators are imposed?

sources.title: Constraining Neutrino Masses, the Cosmological Constant and BSM Physics from the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Could naturally ultralight bosons alter neutrino-scale Casimir vacua? Axions provide motivated masses near or below neutrino thresholds, with additional classical energy possible in winding sectors.

sources.title: Super-light baryo-photons, weak gravity conjecture and exotic instantons in neutron-antineutron transitions

evidence.text: Could neutron–antineutron searches detect a superweak, long-range B−L gauge interaction, and what would such a detection imply for the Weak Gravity Conjecture and B−L-violating exotic string instantons?

sources.title: Quintessence Axion Revisited in Light of Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Can a low-energy symmetry remain exactly global in a theory with quantum gravity? The paper assumes that it cannot, using this conjecture to motivate electroweak B+L violation and to qualify the auxiliary symmetries protecting the supersymmetric model.

sources.title: Aspects of the dark dimension in cosmology

evidence.text: Can a micron-scale dark dimension accommodate neutrino masses, produce distinguishable cosmological and local signals from dynamical KK-graviton dark matter, and support inflation despite the light spin-2 tower?

sources.title: Dark dimension and the standard model landscape

evidence.text: How does a micron-scale dark dimension modify the three-dimensional Casimir-vacuum landscape of SM plus gravity, and the conditional swampland constraints on neutrino masses, neutrino nature, and light gravitinos?

sources.title: Quantum gravity effects on dark matter and gravitational waves

evidence.text: Can quantum-gravity-induced breaking of discrete global symmetries produce correlated, observable dark-matter decay and domain-wall gravitational waves, allowing cosmological observations to constrain an effective symmetry-breaking scale?

sources.title: Kaluza-Klein spectroscopy from neutron oscillations into hidden dimensions

evidence.text: Can neutron mixing with a bulk fermion reveal a finely spaced Kaluza–Klein spectrum through nuclear disappearance and repeated magnetic-field resonances, and what constraints follow from existing neutron experiments?

sources.title: Comments concerning a hypothetical mesoscopic dark dimension

evidence.text: If a speculative micron-scale dark dimension exists, how could it arise in string theory/M-theory, and could gravitational measurements distinguish a circular dimension from an interval with a second boundary universe?

sources.title: Signatures of bulk neutrinos in the early Universe

evidence.text: How do early-universe production and decay of bulk-neutrino KK towers constrain a large extra dimension through matter density and CMB radiation density, and how do those constraints and signatures change for reheating at only a few MeV?

sources.title: Kinetic mixing, proton decay and gravitational waves in SO(10)

evidence.text: Can dimension-five-induced abelian kinetic mixing in an SO(10) model support gauge unification with superheavy strings, observable proton decay and gravitational-wave spectra compatible with the PTA data analyzed in the paper?

sources.title: Dark dimension and the grand unification of forces

evidence.text: Can standard-like grand unification coexist with a micron-sized dark dimension when proton-decay constraints place the X-boson mass far above the five-dimensional Planck scale, and what would this imply for observable gauge excitations?

sources.title: Cosmological constraints on dark neutrino towers

evidence.text: Can weak decays of bulk neutrino KK towers satisfy cosmological photon-injection and extra-radiation bounds in dark-dimension dynamical dark matter, and do these bounds generically exclude micron-sized extra dimensions?

sources.title: Cosmological consequences of domain walls biased by quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can quantum-gravity breaking of a global discrete symmetry make domain walls annihilate with observable consequences for dark radiation, particle dark matter, gravitational waves, primordial black holes, and baby universes?

sources.title: The dark dimension, proton decay, and the length of the M-theory interval

evidence.text: Can the Hořava–Witten interval of strongly coupled E8×E8 heterotic theory realize a micron-scale gravitational dark dimension once proton-decay constraints are imposed, including flat, warped and hypothetical bulk-M5 realizations?

sources.title: Cosmology & Astrophysics of the Dark Dimension with Bulk Majorana Neutrinos

evidence.text: Can bulk Majorana masses prevent cosmological overproduction of sterile-neutrino KK towers while allowing evaporating five-dimensional black holes to communicate bulk physics to observable gamma rays?

sources.title: Theories in more than four dimensions

evidence.text: How can extra dimensions lower the fundamental gravitational scale, and how must neutrino masses, Standard Model extensions, gauge unification and proton stability be reconsidered in that setting? These are introductory lectures reviewing proposals available in 2000.

sources.title: Low scale quantum gravity and double nucleon decay

evidence.text: If proton-decay interactions are forbidden while ΔB = 2 operators survive, can strangeness-changing two-nucleon decays probe a low quantum-gravity scale, and how does the inferred sensitivity depend on hadronic clustering and flavor suppression?

sources.title: Neutrino mass, proton decay and dark matter in TeV scale universal extra dimension models

evidence.text: Can six-dimensional universal extra dimension models with a low fundamental scale simultaneously explain small neutrino masses and suppress nucleon decay, while providing viable Kaluza–Klein dark matter candidates?

sources.title: Supernova and neutron star limits on large extra dimensions reexamined

evidence.text: Does inverse nuclear bremsstrahlung reabsorb gravitationally trapped KK gravitons quickly enough to invalidate neutron-star gamma-ray or heating bounds, and how do supernova and neutron-star bounds scale with the number of large extra dimensions?

sources.title: A Black Hole Conjecture and Rare Decays in Theories with Low Scale Gravity

evidence.text: Can restrictions on light virtual black-hole formation suppress baryon- and lepton-violating processes enough to accommodate TeV-scale gravity, while retaining observable rare-decay signatures?

sources.title: Phenomenology, astrophysics and cosmology of theories with submillimeter dimensions and TeV scale quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can large extra dimensions with near-TeV quantum gravity survive laboratory, stellar-cooling and cosmological constraints, and what additional phenomena become possible when light fields propagate in the bulk?

sources.title: Towards a natural theory of dark energy: Supersymmetric large extra dimensions

evidence.text: Can six-dimensional supergravity with large extra dimensions explain a small, nonzero dark-energy density while keeping it stable against quantum corrections from known particles? The review distinguishes small microscopic parameters from their technical naturalness under integrating out lower-energy physics.

sources.title: Black Holes and Large N Species Solution to the Hierarchy Problem

evidence.text: Couple a test string to the Stückelberg field strength through a boundary term and compare linked and unlinked histories. Their phase difference detects global hair despite vanishing local classical fields.

sources.title: Phenomenology of $10^{32}$ Dark Sectors

evidence.text: Diagonalize permutation-symmetric matrices with common diagonal and off-diagonal entries. The neutron problem reduces to our neutron plus one democratic hidden combination; a magnetic potential supplies a two-state resonance.

sources.title: How neutrino protects the axion

evidence.text: For nonzero neutrino mass, replaces anomalous currents by effective pseudoscalars, integrates the three-form equations with constants β₁ and β₂, and solves constant-field vacuum equations to estimate the residual QCD four-form.

sources.title: Dark Matter and Global Symmetries

evidence.text: For each operator and mass, select the strongest available lifetime bound. Combine published spectral-line searches and imported continuum gamma-ray limits; adapt neutrino bounds to three-body decays using PYTHIA 6.4 and a pointwise non-overshoot prescription.

sources.title: Constraining Neutrino Masses, the Cosmological Constant and BSM Physics from the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Substitute the assumed neutrino mass formula into the eigenmass cap while holding the Yukawa, vacuum energy and specified extra spectrum fixed.

sources.title: Super-light baryo-photons, weak gravity conjecture and exotic instantons in neutron-antineutron transitions

evidence.text: Integrate charged fermionic instanton zero modes to obtain six-quark or trilinear superpotentials and neutrino mass operators; track axionic transformations to discuss gauge invariance and Stückelberg masses.

sources.title: Constraints on the $U(1)_L$ gauge boson in a wide mass range

evidence.text: What constraints apply to the mass and coupling of a gauge boson of total lepton number over mZ′ ≈ 0–10^12 eV, and how do its neutrino couplings and absence of quark couplings change the relevant searches?

sources.title: Precision studies for string derived $Z'$ dynamics at the LHC

evidence.text: How do the extra gauge coupling and abelian kinetic mixing affect resonant Drell–Yan production and forward–backward asymmetry for a heterotic-string-derived Z′, and how strongly do QCD scale and proton-PDF uncertainties limit parameter discrimination?

sources.title: TeV window to grand unification: The Higgs boson’s light color triplet partner

evidence.text: Can a TeV-scale color-triplet Higgs partner with suppressed Yukawa couplings correlate collider production, proton decay, and magnetic-resonance disappearance of neutrons into a sterile neutrino responsible for active-neutrino mass?

sources.title: TASI Lectures on Remnants from the String Landscape

evidence.text: Can characteristic low-energy remnants or violations of established quantum-gravity restrictions test a theory with an inaccessible fundamental scale and many possible vacua?

sources.title: Tracking down the route to the SM with inflation and gravitational waves

evidence.text: Can gravitational-wave backgrounds from defects and first-order phase transitions, combined with proton decay and assumptions about inflation, identify supersymmetric SO(10) breaking routes to the SM and distinguish their non-supersymmetric counterparts?

sources.title: $Z'$s and sterile neutrinos from heterotic string models: exploring $Z'$ mass exclusion limits

evidence.text: How do light sterile-neutrino decay channels change a TeV-scale Z′ width, branching fractions, and dilepton mass-exclusion limits in the specific heterotic-string-derived model studied?

sources.title: Lepton number violation in theories with a large number of Standard Model copies

evidence.text: Does lepton-number violation invalidate a large-copy Standard Model scenario with a TeV-scale gravity cutoff, or can cancellations among Majorana neutrino contributions suppress observable LNV despite spontaneous B−L breaking?

sources.title: Constraining the EW Hierarchy from the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can requiring acceptable lower-dimensional vacua of the Standard Model coupled to gravity restrict four-dimensional neutrino parameters and the Higgs vev? The paper compares Majorana and Dirac realizations through their infrared Casimir spectra.

sources.title: Observable gravitational waves and <math display="inline"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><msub><mrow><mi>N</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>eff</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></math> with global lepton number symmetry and dark matter

evidence.text: Can a global-lepton-number model connecting neutrino masses and fermionic dark matter be tested jointly through gravitational waves from domain-wall annihilation, dark-matter decay, and extra radiation from a light majoron?

sources.title: Axion models with high-scale supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Can approximately universal high-scale supersymmetry breaking accommodate a gravity-protected PQ solution, axion dark matter and gauge coupling unification, while relating the supersymmetry-breaking and PQ-breaking scales?

sources.title: Leptogenesis with Majoron dark matter

evidence.text: Can one minimal Majoron model jointly account for light neutrino masses, freeze-in dark matter and baryon asymmetry, with the same explicit lepton-number-breaking operators controlling dark matter production and resonant leptogenesis?

sources.title: Limiting majoron self-interactions from gravitational wave experiments

evidence.text: Can stochastic gravitational waves from a first-order lepton-symmetry-breaking transition constrain Majoron self-interactions and their new-physics scale, while remaining compatible with collider and cosmological bounds?

sources.title: Lepton number, black hole entropy and 10 to the 32 copies of the Standard Model

evidence.text: Does TeV-scale quantum gravity make lepton-number violation unacceptably large in a model with roughly 10^32 Standard Model copies, or can the neutrino spectrum and coupling constraints suppress observable LNV even when Majorana masses are allowed?
